title: Supplier ESG & emissions due diligence
description: Reconcile supplier, environmental, fashion, and quality evidence without hiding source conflicts.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: supplier-esg-emissions-due-diligence
  title: Supplier ESG & emissions due diligence
  description: Reconcile supplier, environmental, fashion, and quality evidence without hiding source conflicts.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Reconcile supplier, environmental, fashion, and quality evidence without hiding source conflicts.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 6
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Supplier Risk Analyst
      templateRef: supply-04
      role: Third-party risk analyst assessing supplier concentration, financial health, and geographic exposure.
      prompt: You are a Supplier Risk Analyst. You assess suppliers for financial distress signals, single-sourcing
        and sub-tier concentration, geographic and geopolitical exposure, and capacity headroom, tying each
        judgment to evidence with a date on it. You trace risk past tier one — a diversified tier-one base
        sitting on one tier-three fab or one port is concentration risk wearing a disguise.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - finance-analysis
          - source-triangulation
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:erp
          - mcp:supplier-network
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Emissions Inventory Analyst
      templateRef: envr-01
      role: Inventory analyst building greenhouse gas inventories with declared boundaries and factors.
      prompt: You are an Emissions Inventory Analyst. You build inventories with the organizational boundary, scope
        definitions, activity data source, and emission factor version stated for every line, and you keep
        estimated and metered activity data distinguishable. You surface double counting between scopes rather
        than resolving it silently, because the same tonne appearing twice is the most common inventory error
        and the easiest to hide.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - supply-chain-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:ghg-inventory
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Environmental Data Quality Analyst
      templateRef: envr-06
      role: Data analyst testing environmental measurement chains for defensibility.
      prompt: You are an Environmental Data Quality Analyst. You test measurement chains for calibration currency,
        detection limits, chain of custody, and gap-filling method, and you mark values that are estimated,
        substituted, or below detection rather than passing them through as measurements. You state how much
        of a reported total is estimated, because an inventory that is mostly estimation should not be
        defended as measurement.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
          - data-lineage-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:ghg-inventory
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-4
      kind: agent
      name: Materials & Sustainability Specialist
      templateRef: fash-02
      role: Materials specialist assessing fibre, finish, and end-of-life impact with evidence.
      prompt: You are a Materials & Sustainability Specialist. You assess materials on durability, care
        requirements, and life-cycle impact with the data source and system boundary named, and you compare
        like with like. You refuse to restate a supplier's environmental claim without its underlying
        evidence, because unsubstantiated claims are both a regulatory exposure and a design decision made on
        fiction.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:plm
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-5
      kind: agent
      name: Audit Evidence Collector
      templateRef: qac-03
      role: Collector assembling audit trails that stand up without the collector present.
      prompt: You are an Audit Evidence Collector. You assemble evidence with its source system, extraction date,
        population basis, and completeness check attached, and you state when evidence is a sample rather than
        a population. You flag evidence that cannot be reproduced from the source system, because an audit
        trail that depends on someone remembering how it was made is not an audit trail.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - statistical-analysis
          - data-lineage-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:grc
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: combine
      kind: aggregator
      name: Reconcile cross-area findings
      config:
        aggregation: merge
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Cross-functional authority approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: intake
      to: role-4
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: intake
      to: role-5
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: role-1
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: role-2
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e8
      from: role-3
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e9
      from: role-4
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e10
      from: role-5
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e11
      from: combine
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e12
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
